copywriter.title: Prompt 1A
copywriter.body:
I have done some review research and scraped and analyzed hundreds of reviews for a [COMPANY/NICHE] in [STATE]

Imagine you are a professional direct response media buyer (META)

You are working with a client called: [CLIENT WEBSITE]

I have pulled a bunch of reviews from competitors and our [clients reviews - GET RID OF IF NO CLIENT REVIEWS] which are attached

Based on those reviews, I have pulled the top [X] pain points customers have.

What I want you to do is write me 5 strong, scroll stopping hooks for each of the pain points.

Make sure you are not using any testimonials that aren’t real in the hooks

[LIST PAIN POINTS FROM MAIN PAGE IN GOOGLE SHEET]

copywriter.title: Prompt 1B
copywriter.body:
Your next step is too write me video scripts for each of the following hooks.

Each video script should be approximately 30-45 seconds in length.

Make sure you are following this core format for each video script:
- Hook
- Problem
- Agitate
- Solution
- Call to Action

Though you re following this core format/framework - please send them in straight text format without the time stamps

Please add in some form of proof for each such as their reviews (if provided), credibility, publishings, etc. Please pull the proof from their website, or from information in your knowledge base on this client

Use all of the same information provided in this thread.

[LIST PAIN POINTS FROM MAIN PAGE IN GOOGLE SHEET]

copywriter.title: Prompt 2
copywriter.body:
After doing extensive competitor research, I have compiled hundreds of reviews of competitors that do [NICHE] in [STATE]

Out of those hundreds of reviews I have compiled [X] of the most powerful ones to use inside of an AD Campaign.

I need you to do is analyze the [X] reviews.

Then create a hook “5-10 words max” containing each review, I can use in my marketing.

copywriter.title: Prompt 3A
copywriter.body:
I want you to act as a highly experienced direct-response copywriter who specializes in META ads for local service businesses.

Your task is to write 3 different versions of a META ad primary text using the information I provide below.

Each ad should be medium-to-long length, written in a natural, human style, and structured using the PERFORM framework:

P — Problem / hook
E — Explanation of the solution
R — Result / transformation
F — Friction / objections reduced
O — Others / proof
R — Request / CTA
M — Motive / urgency or incentive

Important writing rules:

* Start every ad with a location-specific callout using a location emoji.
  Example: 📍 Lakewood homeowners...
* Use natural line breaks so the copy is easy to read on mobile.
* Use emojis sparingly but effectively.
* Make each version feel meaningfully different from the others.
* Do not sound overly salesy, hypey, robotic, or generic.
* Do not use fake testimonials, fake scarcity, fake urgency, or unsupported claims.
* Do not invent benefits, reviews, prices, guarantees, or proof.
* If information is missing, use the strongest available information and keep the copy honest.
* The CTA should tell people to click the button on the ad, not visit a website.
* Make the copy feel local, trustworthy, and easy to act on.

META compliance rules:

* Do not imply the reader personally has a problem.
* Avoid overly direct callouts like “Are your windows dirty?” or “Do you struggle with...”
* Instead, use softer phrasing like “Many homeowners notice...” or “It’s common for...”
* Do not make unrealistic promises or guaranteed outcomes.
* Do not reference sensitive personal attributes.
* Do not shame, pressure, or scare the reader.
* Keep all claims clear, accurate, and believable.

Product information:

Company website: [ADD COMPANY WEBSITE]

Offer: [ADD OFFER DETAILS]

Location for callout: [LOCATION]

Reviews: [RATING + TOTAL GOOGLE REVIEWS]

Product benefits:
[PULL FROM PRODUCT SPECIFIC BENEFITS PAGE]

Hook / pain point to focus on:
[ADD IN 1 PAIN POINT FROM MAIN SHEET WITH INFORMATION]

Output format:

Ad Version 1 - [Angle Name]
Primary Text:
[Ad copy]

Ad Version 2 - [Angle Name]
Primary Text:
[Ad copy]

Ad Version 3 - [Angle Name]
Primary Text:
[Ad copy]

Compliance Check:
[Briefly explain why these 3 ad copy variations are Meta-compliant]

Before writing, choose 3 unique angles from the information provided. For example:

* Convenience angle
* Trust/proof angle
* Pain relief angle
* Safety angle
* Speed angle
* Value/offer angle
* Local credibility angle

Make sure each version follows the PERFORM structure naturally, but do not label the sections inside the ad copy.

copywriter.title: Prompt 3B
copywriter.body:
Now I want you to write 3 META ad headline variations for the ad copy you just created.

The goal of each headline is to make someone understand what to do next and why they should care, using as few words as possible.

Headline requirements:

* Write 3 different headline options.
* Each headline should be short, ideally 5–7 words.
* Keep the headline punchy, clear, and easy to understand.
* Make each headline feel different from the others.
* Use direct-response language without sounding clickbait or exaggerated.
* Do not use fake urgency, fake scarcity, unrealistic promises, or unsupported claims.
* Do not imply the reader personally has a problem.
* Do not use overly aggressive wording like “Fix your…” or “Stop struggling with…”
* The headline should match the offer, pain point, and angle from the ad copy.
* The CTA should imply clicking the ad button, not visiting a website.
* Emojis are allowed only if they make the headline stronger, but do not force them.

Give me 3 different headline styles to test:

1. Direct CTA Headline
   A clear action-based headline that tells people what to do next.

2. Benefit-Driven Headline
   A headline focused on the main result or transformation.

3. Offer / Incentive Headline
   A headline focused on the offer, deal, consultation, quote, discount, or incentive.

Output format:

Headline 1 - Direct CTA:
[Headline]

Headline 2 - Benefit-Driven:
[Headline]

Headline 3 - Offer / Incentive:
[Headline]

Then give me a short recommendation on which headline is most likely to perform best and why.

data-analyst.title: Prompt #1
data-analyst.body:
Hi - I have uploaded a pdf including over [X] reviews for [NICHE] in [STATE[.

Can you pull the top 7 pain points these customers had, that was solved by their experience with their experience with the company.

data-analyst.title: Prompt #2
data-analyst.body:
Now I want you to hand pick the top 5 reviews that would be the most powerful to use in an ad campaign

Provide those to me.

data-analyst.title: Prompt #3
data-analyst.body:
Please analyze this website: [ADD CLIENT WEBSITE]

Also analyze the companies reviews which I have uploaded [ONLY ADD IN IF COMPANY HAS REVIEWS]

I need to find the companies top 5 benefits which sets them apart from their competition.
